purpose: Share expenses and goals with the people you live with.
see: Your household's members. · Shared expenses and how they're split. · Who owes whom.
do: Invite someone by email. · Choose how to split: 50/50 or another proportion. · Mark an account as settled.

faq.q: Can they see all my data?
faq.a: Only what you share with the household. Everything else stays yours.
Yes, right from here. Settle up before you leave.
